description: This file defines the 'StreamSupervisor' interface responsible for supervising materialized streams within the Eclipse Ditto streaming gateway. It declares a method to supervise a WebSocket stream, passing relevant identifiers and headers.

classes.name: StreamSupervisor
classes.description: An interface providing supervision capabilities for streams in the streaming gateway.

methods.name: supervise
methods.description: Method to supervise a WebSocket stream with associated correlation ID and headers.
